benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Apart from the rewards program, PhonePe Ultimo credit cardholders get the option to avail domestic lounge access by meeting the quarterly spending condition. While the joining fee cost can be overcome through the welcome benefit worth the same amount, the annual fee comes with its own waiver condition. Both these conditions lean towards the lower side and hence can be met by any average spender too. Read on to know more about the card features and benefits in detail.

faqs.q: Can reward points earned using PhonePe Ultimo HDFC credit card be auto-credited as cashback?
faqs.a: No, the earned reward points can be redeemed as cashback against statement balance by request only. You can request for cashback accrual by logging into your card account.

faqs.q: Is there any cashback redemption fee applicable on HDFC Ultimo credit card?
faqs.a: No, no fee is charged on cashback redemption of the accrued reward points.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum transaction amount for rewards earnings on PhonePe HDFC Ultimo credit card?
faqs.a: Yes, only the card transactions that are worth Rs. 100 or more are eligible for accrual of reward points.

faqs.q: How many reward points can I earn using PhonePe HDFC Ultimo credit card?
faqs.a: You can earn a maximum of 2,000 reward points every month using HDFC PhonePe Ultimo credit card.

faqs.q: Can I link PhonePe HDFC Bank Credit Card to other UPI apps apart from PhonePe?
faqs.a: Yes, you can link PhonePe Ultimo HDFC credit card to any UPI app other than PhonePe as well, including Google Pay, BHIM UPI, Paytm, CRED, etc.

faqs.question: Is the PhonePe HDFC Bank Ultimo Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: The card is mainly useful for PhonePe bills, recharges and travel bookings, where it offers 10% rewards. It also offers 5% rewards on select online merchants. The monthly caps limit the upside, but the reward rates are good for a ₹999 + GST card.

faqs.question: How much cashback can I earn with the PhonePe HDFC Bank Ultimo Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You can earn up to 2000 Reward Points per month. This includes 1000 RP from the 10% PhonePe category, 500 RP from the 5% online category and 500 RP from UPI Scan & Pay.

faqs.question: Does the PhonePe HDFC Bank Ultimo Credit Card give 10% cashback on utility bills?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible recharges and bill payments made through PhonePe earn 10% Reward Points, subject to a maximum of 1000 RP per month.

faqs.question: Does the PhonePe HDFC Bank Ultimo Credit Card give rewards on train tickets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible train bookings made through PhonePe fall under the 10% Travel & Stays reward category. Flights, buses and hotel bookings through PhonePe are also covered.

faqs.question: Does the PhonePe HDFC Bank Ultimo Credit Card earn rewards on UPI payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible UPI Scan & Pay transactions earn 1% Reward Points, capped at 500 RP per month. The payment needs to be made by scanning a merchant QR code.
